app_identity.name: VelvetNote Studio & E-Card Haven
app_identity.concept: A dual-experience digital stationery platform merging editorial luxury design with powerful interactive creation (Canvas Card Builder, Pre-made E-Card Shop, Business Admin Studio, and Interactive Animated Card Delivery).
app_identity.archetype: Organic & Tactile Luxury meets Soft Editorial Utility

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.caption: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400

layout_patterns.navigation: Sticky semi-transparent header with backdrop-blur-md (bg-white/80 dark:bg-black/80), clear tab switcher between Shop, Interactive Builder, Admin Studio, and Live Previewer.
layout_patterns.storefront_grid: The Tetris Bento Grid: 12-column staggered grid for featured e-cards with filters for occasion, style, audio type, and price.
layout_patterns.builder_workspace: Persistent 3-panel layout: Left toolbar (Fonts, Colors, Shapes, Clip Art, Uploads, AI Assistant), Center dynamic canvas with real-time drag/scale controls, Right media & delivery bar (Audio, Recorded Voice, Video Message, Envelope Customizer).
layout_patterns.card_viewer: Immersive full-screen overlay experience with envelope unfolding animation, particle confetti, background music playback, and voice/video message player.
layout_patterns.admin_studio: High-density dashboard with tabs for Asset Library (Frames, Clip Art, Sounds), Card Templates Manager, Orders & Analytics, and Pricing setup.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/75 dark:bg-zinc-900/75 border border-amber-900/10 dark:border-white/10 shadow-lg
visual_enhancers.paper_texture: subtle grain noise backdrop pattern overlay for authentic physical stationery feel
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: hover border glow with subtle amber/gold accent stroke

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-xl with subtle hover lift (-translate-y-0.5) and crisp active press state. Primary CTAs use Terracotta Coral (#E05A47) or Deep Emerald (#3A5A40).
component_guidelines.canvas_editor: Interactive SVG/HTML5 canvas allowing drag, scale, rotate, z-index ordering, font swapping, color picking, frame attachment, clip-art stickers, AI message generation, and AI clip-art creation.
component_guidelines.audio_player: Custom retro vinyl or waveform player with play/pause, volume slider, track selector, and mic voice recorder.
component_guidelines.toasts: Sonner toasts with custom dark/light theme for saving draft, adding music, AI generation complete, and order checkout success.

motion_and_interactions.framing: Framer motion page transitions, smooth stagger effects for template grids
motion_and_interactions.envelope_animation: 3D-like flap open transition, letter sliding out, wax seal breaking effect with audio sound effect
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Heart/favorite toggles with spring physics, clip-art sticker snap-to-grid visuals, playback audio visualizer dots

instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Build the 3 main user areas in a unified seamless app (Header tab switcher or seamless route transitions): 1) Pre-made Card Shop (Browse, Filter, Instant Quick-Personalize, Cart & Stripe Modal Checkout), 2) Custom Interactive Card Builder (Full Canvas studio with shapes, frames, clip art, custom images, AI message writer, AI clip-art generator, background sound selector, voice recorder, video upload preview), 3) Business Admin Studio (Template CRUD, asset uploads, clip-art management, audio library manager, orders table). 4) Public Interactive E-Card Delivery Viewer (Envelope opening animation, sound auto-play, personalized voice/video, confetti animation, reply note feature).
instructions_to_main_agent.data_test_ids: Ensure ALL interactive buttons, canvas tools, form inputs, navigation tabs, cards, and modal triggers have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-builder-tab', data-testid='canvas-add-text-btn', data-testid='ai-generate-msg-btn', data-testid='checkout-stripe-btn', data-testid='envelope-open-btn').
instructions_to_main_agent.icon_library: Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for modern studio icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_toggle: Include dark/light mode toggle in header so users can experience the app in both editorial warm light and dramatic dark themes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and standard blue gradients. Use organic warm tones (#FAF7F2, #E05A47, #3A5A40, #D4AF37) with elegant serif typography (Playfair Display/Cormorant Garamond).
Never use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or headers without strong backdrop blur or solid fallback.
Do NOT use universal CSS transitions like transition: all; specify exact property transitions.
Every interactive element MUST have hover, active, focus states, and a data-testid attribute for stable testing.

Provide high quality pre-loaded mock assets (songs like 'Acoustic Birthday', 'Lofi Romance', 'Jazz Celebration', clip-arts, frames, stickers) so the card builder and admin studio are instantly functional and fun to test.
